content: प्रश्लिष्ट {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Twisted, entwined. .²2 Reasonable, well-argued or reasoned (युक्तियुत). .{@-ष्टः@} .²1 A term applied to the Sandhi of the vowel अ with a following vowel and of other vowels with other homogeneous ones. .²2 The vowel resulting from this Sandhi. .²3 The accent with which such substituted vowel is pronounced.
